David Chen
Java Developer
San Jose, CA | (408) 555-0122 | david.chen@email.com | linkedin.com/in/david-chen-java
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Highly structured Backend Software Engineer with 4+ years of specialized experience spanning the full Software
Development Lifecycle (SDLC). Proficient in building scalable, high-volume, low-latency microservices architectures
utilizing Java 11/17 and the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Security, Data JPA). Skilled in modernizing legacy
database setups, containerizing infrastructures with Docker, and establishing robust automated testing patterns.
CORE COMPETENCIES
(cid:127) Core Java (11 / 17) (cid:127) Spring Boot & Spring Cloud (cid:127) Microservices Architecture
(cid:127) RESTful API Development (cid:127) Hibernate / JPA / ORM (cid:127) SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL)
(cid:127) Docker Containerization (cid:127) CI/CD & Git Workflows (cid:127) JUnit & Mockito Testing
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Java Developer – Stratum Software Systems 2023 – Present
(cid:127) Engineered, tested, and scaled high-volume backend microservices using Java 17 and Spring Boot, maintaining
exceptional low-latency performance thresholds.
(cid:127) Designed robust, highly secure RESTful APIs leveraging Spring Security OAuth2 protocols to connect critical
third-party financial clearing systems.
(cid:127) Optimized database access architectures using Hibernate ORM and PostgreSQL query tuning, achieving a 22%
reduction in transactional latency overhead.
(cid:127) Established comprehensive automated testing pipelines using JUnit and Mockito, raising application test coverage to
**92%** and preventing production deployment bugs.
Associate Java Engineer – Beacon Tech Labs 2022 – 2023
(cid:127) Deconstructed legacy monolithic application modules into clean, decoupled, domain-driven microservice blocks.
(cid:127) Containerized core application services utilizing Docker to ensure flawless system replication across dev, testing,
and production environments.
(cid:127) Participated actively in pull request reviews, code refactoring sprints, and CI/CD automated build configurations via
Jenkins.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering – Engineering University (2021)
